label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Email Marketing
body: Email marketing is sending targeted messages to a group of people who have given you permission to contact them directly.
caption:
Think of it like sending a personalized newsletter to your fans or customers. You might share updates on your latest creations, offer exclusive tips, or announce a new product. It's a direct way to connect and build relationships with people interested in what you do. Consider setting up a simple email list to stay in touch! 👋
